mesh_export_help: Paste the complete content of JungHome.json (JUNG HOME app: Project → Project handover). It contains all mesh keys and is stored encrypted.
own_address_help: Unicast address of this adapter as 4 hex digits, outside the range of the JUNG HOME app (e.g. 0D01). Never use the same address in two instances.
proxy_host_help: Host name or IP address of an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy with active connections
proxy_key_help: Base64 key from api: encryption: key of the proxy, empty if the proxy has no encryption
poll_help: The thermostat reports setpoint changes by itself; polling also fetches the room temperature
